npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: God save you. What news of the parish?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Dia is Muire dhuit, friend! The spring plowing has every coulter and spade in the parish worn thin, so the hearth is kept roaring from dawn till dusk. What brings ye down our way this fine morning?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron leans on his heavy hammer with a hearty grin.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: How does the harvest look this year?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Sure, it is early yet to tell of the harvest, but the seed is going into good, crumbly earth with the spring drying up the ground nicely. The farmers bringing their shares to the anvil seem in rare good heart for the crop ahead. Have ye traveled far along the roads today?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron leans a heavy hammer against the anvil and wipes his brow with a forearm.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Have you seen Father Declan today?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I haven't laid eyes on Father Declan since yesterday's Mass, mo chara. He'll likely be about St. Brigid's Church or making his rounds to the sick this morning.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron leans on the anvil with a broad grin.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: And how is your own family keeping?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Buíochas le Dia, the house is thriving! Maire is in great spirits, and young Colm here is getting so handy with the tongs he'll soon put his old father out of a job. Are your own people in good health?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron claps a heavy hand on Colm's shoulder with a broad grin.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Is old Festus the cooper still at his shop by the bridge?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I know no one by the name of Festus in these parts, nor any cooper's shop set up by the bridge. If 'tis barrels or iron hoop work ye're looking after, ye'd have to look elsewhere or make do with what I can hoop for ye here.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his brow with the back of a calloused hand.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: How do I get to the abbey in town?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: There is no abbey in these parts, friend, so ye'll find no road leading to one. The only house of prayer hereabouts is St. Brigid's Church down the way. Were ye hoping to meet someone there, or find shelter?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his brow with a leather-clad forearm and smiles.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Tell me about your work, but keep it brief.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I shape the iron that keeps this whole parish turning, from the shoes on the horses to plowshares, gates, and hinges. 'Tis hot, honest labour from morning till dusk, and there's little in iron I cannot mend or make anew.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron taps a heavy hammer lightly against the anvil with a grin.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: I cannot sleep for worrying. What would you advise?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: A hard day's physical labour will cure sleeplessness quicker than anything else, mo chara, for a tired body leaves no room for fretful thoughts. If 'tis a troubled mind beyond mere idleness, a quiet word with Father Declan or a draught of herbs from Brigid Ni Fhatharta might set ye right. What is it that's weighing so heavy on ye?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron leans casually against the anvil with a hearty smile.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Do you know Padraig Darcy?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Aye, I know Padraig well! A grand man who keeps Darcy's Pub and always has a warm hearth and good company waiting.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron grins and leans on the anvil horn.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: What can you tell me of Ballyglass Castle?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I know of no castle by that name in these parts, mo chara. You'll find stone cottages, farms, and the old church hereabouts, but no grand castles anywhere in this parish.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his brow with the back of his hand and smiles broadly.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: I heard Cormac Duffy was at the mill. Is that true?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I cannot say for certain where Cormac is standing this very morning, though as the parish miller, The Mill is where he spends most of his days. If ye have grain to grind or business with him, that would surely be the first place to seek him out.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron leans a heavy hammer against the anvil and smiles.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Thank you. I should let you return to your work.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: You're grand, mo chara! Slán leat, and mind the road as ye go.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron gives a cheerful wave with his tongs.*
